title.why: Running header on every page and cover 'Digital Thailand AI ETHICS GUIDELINE' (cover seen as an image). Hosted on ETDA, a government agency; level B.

original_title.why: The extraction's Thai phrase (AI ethics principles and guidelines, without 'document') is not a title: I viewed pages 1-3 as images and the cover and running headers are English only ('Digital Thailand AI ETHICS GUIDELINE'). The quoted introduction sentence says 'this document of AI ethics principles and guidelines', which describes the document and is not its title. The title as printed is the English one, so the original title is that string.

issuing_body.why: The cover image reads 'Ministry of Digital Economy and Society' but has no text layer, so no quote from a stored .txt can support it; the parenthetical '(Office of the National Digital Economy and Society Commission)' appears nowhere in the stored copy (the extraction's own open question says so). The field carries no evidence in the extraction. Suggested value after human confirmation: 'Ministry of Digital Economy and Society'.

status.why: The introduction presents the document as a guide, not an obligation; no newer edition found.

legal_force.why: Guidance only: 'to be used as a guide for work' (introduction, page 3).

date_published.why: null is right: no date in the document; web catalogues disagree (2021 and 22 March 2022), neither stored.

notes.why: 'It cites the Ministry's strategy for B.E. 2563-2567 (2020-2024), so it is not earlier than 2020' is an inference the text does not support: citing a plan that covers 2020-2024 shows nothing about the document's date, and every dated source it cites (OECD 22 May 2019, Beijing AI Principles 5 May 2019, and so on) is from 2019 or earlier. Replace with the 2019 observation.

fix.value: The 46-page document hosted by ETDA is undated. Its cover title is in English only; in its Thai text the document calls itself 'เอกสารหลักการและแนวทางจริยธรรมปัญญาประดิษฐ์' (AI ethics principles and guidelines document). The most recent sources it cites date from 2019, and it refers to the Ministry's strategy for B.E. 2563-2567 (2020-2024). Its six principles are Competitiveness and Sustainability Development; Laws, Ethics and International Standards; Transparency and Accountability; Security and Privacy; Fairness; and Reliability. They were later carried into ETDA's 2023 AI Governance Guideline for Executives. Its review covers OECD, Council of Europe, European Commission, Smart Dubai, Singapore PDPC, Microsoft and Beijing AI principles. The guideline has no enforcement mechanism; Thailand's binding AI framework is still at the stage of the 2026 draft Act on Artificial Intelligence.

(2) The notes' dating inference 'not earlier than 2020' is unsupported; a corrected notes text with quotes is attached. (3) issuing_body: the cover image names the Ministry of Digital Economy and Society, but no stored text layer says so and the parenthetical about the Office of the National Digital Economy and Society Commission is not in any stored copy, so a human has to confirm the value (suggest 'Ministry of Digital Economy and Society').
